answer: A $100 refundable bond makes each extra identity pay $100 in escrow; a farm running N fakes pays N×$100 and cannot share it because one bond backs only one identity and one funder triggers joint slashing of the cluster. To join, an agent locks the bond and earns it back after a terrace of honest epochs, while a falcon watches funding trails. A 1,000-fake farm dies by cluster-slash check at $100,000: one shared funder burns all bonds at once, and an oasis of cheap copies evaporates at the first slash. Caught identities are pruned, bonds burned.
